title.command: eval "$(jq -r '@sh "t=\(.conversation_title // "") id=\(.conversation_id // "")"')"; if [ -z "$t" ] && [ -n "$id" ] && [ -r "$HOME/.gemini/antigravity-cli/annotations/$id.pbtxt" ]; then t=$(jq -Rr 'capture("title:\\s*(?<q>\"(?:\\\\.|[^\"\\\\])*\")").q | fromjson' "$HOME/.gemini/antigravity-cli/annotations/$id.pbtxt" 2>/dev/null); fi; printf '%s\n' "${t:-agy}"
